limitations: GateUp has a real-input countercase and remains the sixteen-warp parent. T3 is separately regression-protected, not automatically retiled.
Standalone operator graph samples are warm-resident diagnostics, not whole-model DRAM or speed claims. E2E gains are measured separately.
D2 parent reference is the earlier same-session accepted full 3+10 candidate cohort; no D2 acceleration claim.
Full-model D2 memcheck belongs to the earlier selection campaign; this leaf-kernel change uses targeted Trellis memcheck, model parity and adjacent full D2 evidence.
Per-run output arrays are represented by SHA-256 of canonical compact JSON; complete raw JSON files remain identified in raw_evidence.
Bounded Linux text evidence; no Windows/media/everyday-context release qualification.

from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,shutil,os,hashlib,subprocess
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(OUT.parent/'decode-cost-audit'))
import audit_run as a
a.OUT=OUT
for n in ['paths.json','prompt.ids']:shutil.copyfile(OUT.parent/'decode-cost-audit'/n,OUT/n)
parent=OUT.parent/'allowed-top1/gem16-run-candidate';candidate=OUT/'gem16-run-candidate'
shutil.copy2(a.BIN/'gem16-run',candidate)
for name,p in [('parent',parent),('candidate',candidate)]:
 (OUT/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size},indent=2)+'\n')
a.record('cuda-and-host',['ctest','--test-dir',str(a.BIN.parent),'--output-on-failure','-R','^gem16-(unit|cuda|cuda-trellis35|cuda-moe-reference|cuda-attention-reference|cuda-nvfp4-consumption)$'],240)
a.record('memcheck-trellis',['compute-sanitizer','--tool','memcheck','--error-exitcode','99',str(a.BIN/'gem16-cuda-trellis35-tests')],240)
a.probes()
for profile in ['12b','nvfp4']:
 vectors=[]
 for mode in ['ordinary','d2']:
  args=a.base(mode,64,a.PATHS['12b_target' if profile=='12b' else 'nvfp4'])
  start=args.index('--input-token-ids-file');args[start:start+2]=['--input-token-ids','2,105,2364,107,40654,607,7121,506,3658,3730,236761,106,107,105,4368,107,100,45518,107,101']
  if profile=='12b':
   args[args.index('--max-context')+1]='4096'
   if mode=='d2':args[args.index('--assistant-model')+1]=a.PATHS['12b_assistant']
  p=a.record('regression-'+profile+'-'+mode,args,180);vectors.append(a.validate(p,64)['output_token_ids'])
 assert vectors[0]==vectors[1]
env=os.environ.copy();env.update(GEM16_12B_MODEL=a.PATHS['12b_target'],GEM16_M22_RAW_DIR=str(OUT/'12b-product-fixture'))
a.record('12b-product',['ctest','--test-dir',str(a.BIN.parent),'--output-on-failure','-R','^gem16-12b-m22-product$'],180,env)
a.profiles(8)
import sqlite3
facts={}
for mode in ['ordinary','d2']:
 c=sqlite3.connect(OUT/(mode+'-8-trace.sqlite'))
 count=c.execute("select count(*) from CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL k join StringIds s on s.id=k.shortName where s.value='MmaW4A8ProjectionSelectedN128EightWarpKernel'").fetchone()[0]
 assert count==(210 if mode=='ordinary' else 60),(mode,count)
 facts[mode]={'actual_eight_warp_down_calls':count,'outputs':8,'context':17519}
(OUT/'dispatch.json').write_text(json.dumps(facts,indent=2)+'\n')
print('M1 DOWN CANDIDATE CORRECTNESS, MEMORY AND ACTUAL DISPATCH PASSED',flush=True)
# Primary comparison: AB/BA ordinary plus an adjacent full D2 candidate cohort.
sys.path.insert(0,str(OUT.parent/'allowed-top1'))
s=(OUT.parent/'allowed-top1/compare.py').read_text()
s=s.replace("OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent", "OUT=Path("+repr(str(OUT))+ ")")
s=s.replace("('parent-d2','d2',parent),", "")
exec(compile(s,str(OUT/'comparison-source.py'),'exec'))
